2026-09-25-night-page-break-fix-three-ar.decision: Lookahead arm F not shipped; the no-lookahead PAGE_BREAK_SCOPED variant went live instead (PR #5170)

2026-09-25-retraction-of-the-arm-label-o.verdict: The harness matched 'repaired' but outcomes say 'repair', so both #4681 seam draws judged the plain draft: the 19-14 tie is plain batch vs production; the repair was never judged.

2026-09-25-round-4-guards-echo-gate-size.verdict: Echo gate flags 166 of 225,583 judged pages (0.07%) after three exemptions, 8 of 11 hand-read real; about 5% of production blocks return short and now go single-page.

2026-09-25-round-4-page-break-fix-harden.verdict: Hardened fix Fs2 beats production 10-5-9 on the 24 device breaks, defective 38% vs 58%, duplication 2 vs 6; one seam shape (syllable catchword on an open sentence) fails in both rounds.

2026-09-25-which-engine-should-retransla.verdict: Against 84000, MITRA-MT trails Gemini badly (fidelity median 3 vs 5, invention 50%); flash mean 4.79, lite 4.43, and lite is the rule's cheapest eligible engine.
2026-09-25-which-engine-should-retransla.decision: MITRA-MT not used for manuscript-OCR Tibetan; lite vs flash left PENDING Derek, re-measured on Batch 2026-10-01 (#4742)

2026-09-26-by-eye-reference-for-the-free.verdict: Two-leaf by-eye reads accepted 142 of 184 held IA books (3 of 9 pilot, 139 of 175 cohort); the split follows the scan, not the date. CER and paid-gate agreement unmeasured.

2026-09-26-page-break-fix-scoped-and-in-.verdict: In production's 8-page block shape the scoped fix wins device breaks 11-3-10 (defective 29% vs 50%, duplication 6 to 1); plain breaks unchanged; A/A floor 18-19.
2026-09-26-page-break-fix-scoped-and-in-.decision: PAGE_BREAK_SCOPED with adjacent-page OCR flipped ON in translateBatch and translatePage (PR #5170)

2026-09-28-for-which-english-ia-books-ma.verdict: Against English references lite beats the Archive's OCR on the same page 57-5 (43 ties); the Archive silently misreads about 1.5% of printed numbers, lite 0 of 750.
2026-09-28-for-which-english-ia-books-ma.decision: Archive text admitted only for number-free 1880-1930 Latin-script pages (ia-ocr-cohort.mjs) and as refusal fallback; lite stays default (#5186)

2026-09-28-is-flash-lite-adequate-on-mod.verdict: Flash beats lite 14-3 (75 ties) on 114 English reference pages but the median difference is 0.00 pp; both fail on RECITATION refusals (lite 14.9%, flash 17.5%).
2026-09-28-is-flash-lite-adequate-on-mod.decision: Lite kept for English print; a refusal-fallback lane is the open item (PR #5248, Derek 2026-09-29)

2026-09-28-which-cheap-model-draws-accur.verdict: Flash draws 81.6% tight boxes vs 3.1-lite 8-21% (finds pictures but crops them) and Qwen3-VL 63%; flash on the Batch API reproduces realtime boxes at half price.
2026-09-28-which-cheap-model-draws-accur.decision: Extraction stays on gemini-3-flash-preview, routed to the Batch API by default (IMAGE_EXTRACTION_USE_BATCH, PR #5238)

2026-09-29-chained-batch-api-translation.verdict: Chained Batch lane wrote 847 pages of 5 stalled books at $0.00056/page (4.3x under realtime), median round 2.7 min; 16% of rounds cancelled, all recovered.
2026-09-29-chained-batch-api-translation.decision: Chained Batch lane merged (PR #5267) and runs from the production crontab; seam-repair design (#4912/#4973 arm Et) retired

2026-09-29-does-a-stronger-image-matcher.verdict: The CLIP index at probes=1 hid matches (top-1 21 to 30 of 63 at probes 10); SigLIP2 fp32 beats CLIP on top-1, 59 vs 49 (random pool) and 47 vs 34 (hard negatives).
2026-09-29-does-a-stronger-image-matcher.decision: probes=10 shipped (PR #5256); SigLIP2 as the /identify recall model awaits Derek (#3193)

2026-09-29-does-image-preprocessing-bina.verdict: Only per-leaf cropping helps (Yigdzin +46 matched Derge syllables per page, 98-2); Otsu hurts every engine; Sauvola, CLAHE, deskew and upscaling are null or harmful.
2026-09-29-does-image-preprocessing-bina.decision: No preprocessing step added to the OCR path; leafcrop (production since 09-28) kept (#5250)

2026-09-29-round-2-of-5250-do-tighter-ba.verdict: Band crops do not beat leafcrop for Yigdzin (identity -9 pp, duplicated lines); photometric arms null for Yigdzin, but unsharp, flatten and denoise help Kraken on Syriac.
2026-09-29-round-2-of-5250-do-tighter-ba.decision: Band crops not adopted; the exploratory Kraken gains went to a fresh-page replication (round 3, #5250)

2026-09-29-round-3-of-5250-do-the-round-.verdict: On 80 fresh Syriac folios every prediction held: sauvola -3.8 pp CER on dark spreads, flatten -10.6 pp on clean leaves, unsharp helps both; flatten hurts dark spreads.
2026-09-29-round-3-of-5250-do-the-round-.decision: No lane change; per-stratum routing was then tested on library pages and did not transfer (#5277)

2026-09-30-can-a-0-per-page-garble-score.verdict: A $0 lexicon and repetition garble score reaches precision 0.24-0.60 and recall 0.09-0.19 against the judge's 32 positives; corpus precision about 15-20%.
